_comment: Context accounting for BOTH legs, pinned so nothing is DERIVED per-leg. Two separate bugs live here. (1) aider knows nothing about a raw vLLM endpoint served as `openai/coder`, so it never trims and never warns, and --no-show-model-warnings (needed headless) hides that it is flying blind — a T3 that grows past the pod's --max-model-len 32768 gets a vLLM 400, which is the confound the 2026-07-22 run died of. (2) LESS OBVIOUS: without an entry for the LOCAL model, aider takes Ollama's advertised 262144, while aider.model.settings.yml caps the real window at num_ctx 32768 — a value aider cannot see. The same physical overflow would then be refused on the hosted leg (400 -> void) but silently TRUNCATED on the local leg and graded as a model failure. Same limit, opposite verdicts. Both entries are 32768 to match how the pod is booted (max_len in the fleet json) and how Ollama is pinned (num_ctx).
_comment_muse: Added 2026-08-14 for the muse-glimmer leg. IDENTICAL numbers to the qwen entry on purpose — this harness's whole claim is that only the MODEL differs between legs, so a context or output budget tuned per-model would void the comparison it exists to make. ⚠️ muse-glimmer is a THINKING model: reasoning and content share max_output_tokens, so 8192 buys it less usable output than it buys qwen. That asymmetry is REAL and is not corrected here — correcting it would unmatch the legs. If its T2/T3 diffs come back empty, suspect budget starvation before concluding the edit was never applied, and see docs/LOCAL-CODER-FAILURES.md for the same trap in the S2 probe.
